item.text: {"search_note":"I found strong evidence on the cabinet, finance ministry, security command, and anti-corruption apparatus, but much weaker direct evidence on the party as an organized machine. There is little in the 2024 record I found that shows UDPS or a broader ruling-party structure being systematically mobilized beyond appointments, coalition bargaining, and public messaging.","evidence":[{"title":"Cabinet formation translated the post-election coalition into a governing team.","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-05-29","url":"https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/DR-Congo-names-new-government-after-months-of-delay-46846207/","summary":"Tshisekedi ended months of government delay by naming Judith Suminwa as prime minister and then forming a large cabinet. This shows real mobilization of the coalition and bureaucracy, though the long delay also shows bargaining and fragmentation.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"Suminwa’s appointment was a concrete competence-and-inclusion move.","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-04-01","url":"https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/dr-congo-president-appoints-countrys-first-female-prime-minister-2024-04-01/","summary":"Reuters said Tshisekedi appointed Judith Suminwa, a planning minister and technocrat, as prime minister after coalition uncertainty. That is evidence of mobilizing the executive team around a governing program rather than purely patronage.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.2"]},{"title":"The presidency explicitly framed Suminwa’s role as technocratic.","publisher":"Ministère de la Communication et Médias","date":"2024-04-01","url":"https://communication.gouv.cd/actualites/communications-du-gouvernement/18/madame-judith-suminwa-tuluka-nommee-premiere-ministre-de-la-republique-democratique-du-congo","summary":"The presidency said Suminwa was chosen for her skills and development-planning experience. This supports the reading that Tshisekedi tried to align the top of government with his program, not only with loyalists.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"A strategic finance portfolio went to a career technocrat.","publisher":"ACP","date":"2024-05-30","url":"https://acp.cd/economie/rdc-fwamba-likunde-un-technocrate-rompu-a-la-tete-du-ministere-des-finances-par-elysee-kakese/","summary":"ACP described Doudou Fwamba as a finance technocrat with public-finance experience. This is strong evidence that Tshisekedi used bureaucracy, not just party loyalty, to execute his economic agenda.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"The IMF program gave Tshisekedi a real administrative vehicle for fiscal execution.","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-11-13","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/11/13/pr-24416-drc-imf-reaches-agreement-on-ecf-and-rsf","summary":"The IMF package tied the government to spending-chain controls, Treasury reforms, decentralization of spending authorization, revenue mobilization, and governance/transparency measures. This is strong evidence of the state apparatus being mobilized around a concrete policy program.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.2"]},{"title":"The finance ministry was actively used to negotiate and carry out reforms.","publisher":"Ministère du Budget","date":"2024-11-15","url":"https://budget.gouv.cd/deux-nouveaux-programmes-avec-le-fmi-aime-boji-et-doudou-fwamba-etaient-devant-la-presse/","summary":"The budget ministry said the finance and budget ministers jointly presented the IMF programs and that coordination had improved since June 2024. That suggests the fiscal bureaucracy was being mobilized in a sustained way.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.2"]},{"title":"The IMF also reported concrete administrative correction inside the state.","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-07-03","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/07/03/pr24253-drc-imf-exec-board-concludes-2024-art-iv-consult-completes-6th-rev-ecf-arr","summary":"The IMF said the authorities cleaned up the civil-service register with biometrics, reorganized civil-service social security, and advanced Treasury Single Account and expenditure-chain reforms. That is evidence of an operating bureaucracy, not just rhetoric.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.2"]},{"title":"Education policy was implemented through a specific delivery program.","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-02-28","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/02/28/democratic-republic-congo-afe-expanding-and-equipping-primary-school-classrooms-for-better-learning-outcomes","summary":"PEQIP included classrooms, materials, teacher training, merit-based recruitment, stronger information systems, and decentralized planning. This shows Tshisekedi’s program reaching the bureaucracy in a concrete sector.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.2"]},{"title":"He mobilized formal military command structures repeatedly.","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-07-05","url":"https://presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/securite_a_lest_le_chef_de_letat_a_reuni_la_task_force_du_haut_commandement_militaire","summary":"Tshisekedi convened the military high-command task force, received tactical assessments, and ordered action to safeguard territorial integrity. This is direct evidence of mobilizing the defense apparatus toward a chosen security goal.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"He repeated that command coordination through a second interagency meeting.","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-07-09","url":"https://presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/securite_dans_lest_le_chef_de_l_etat_a_preside_la_deuxieme_reunion_de_la_task_force_du_haut_commandement_militaire","summary":"Tshisekedi chaired a second task-force meeting with defense, security, and finance officials and ordered implementation of decided measures. That suggests sustained, not one-off, mobilization of the state apparatus.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.2"]},{"title":"P-DDRCS was a named institutional channel for state mobilization against armed groups.","publisher":"ACP","date":"2024-03-22","url":"https://acp.cd/nation/programme-de-desarmement-et-demobilisation-une-alternative-pour-la-paix-et-la-cohesion-sociale/","summary":"The government presented P-DDRCS as a stabilization, peace, and cohesion program meant to restore state authority where absent. This is direct evidence of mobilizing an institutional network toward demobilization and state recovery.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"A new P-DDRCS coordination team shows continued institutional follow-through.","publisher":"ACP","date":"2024-12-20","url":"https://acp.cd/nation/programme-de-desarmement-et-relevement-communautaire-nomination-dune-nouvelle-equipe-de-coordination-nationale/","summary":"The presidency appointed a new national coordination team for P-DDRCS late in 2024. That suggests the stabilization apparatus was still being staffed and maintained, not abandoned after launch.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.2"]},{"title":"He used anti-corruption oversight as part of his governing network.","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-10-07","url":"https://www.presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/le_chef_de_l_etat_a_assiste_a_louverture_de_la_session_extraordinaire_du_conseil_superieur_de_la_cour_des_comptes","summary":"Tshisekedi publicly backed the Court of Accounts’ control function, and the court linked his support to revived anti-corruption oversight and public-finance control. This is evidence of mobilizing accountability institutions toward his governance goals.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"He later remade the top of the military in a major reshuffle.","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-12-20","url":"https://theprint.in/world/congolese-president-sacks-military-top-brass-in-major-reshuffle/2411531/","summary":"Tshisekedi replaced the army chief, military intelligence head, and many senior officers in one of the biggest shake-ups in years. This is clear evidence of late-year remedial mobilization of the security hierarchy, though it may also reflect damage control.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.2"]},{"title":"The security system still looked fragmented and proxy-dependent.","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-07-17","url":"https://theprint.in/world/army-disarray-hobbles-congos-fight-with-rwanda-backed-rebels-officers-say/2160048/","summary":"Officers described mismanagement, weak logistics, demoralized troops, and over-reliance on Wazalendo militias. Tshisekedi reportedly told them to be brought in line, but the key finding is that he did not have full command over the force structure he was trying to mobilize.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.2"]},{"title":"The government relied on militias it did not control.","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-07-17","url":"https://theprint.in/world/army-disarray-hobbles-congos-fight-with-rwanda-backed-rebels-officers-say/2160048/","summary":"Reuters said the army had no control over Wazalendo and that they were poorly trained and undisciplined. This is strong negative evidence for effective mobilization of the ruling network toward a coherent program.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.2"]},{"title":"The presidency itself was vulnerable to serious security failure.","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-05-19","url":"https://www.tbsnews.net/worldbiz/africa/democratic-republic-congo-army-says-it-thwarted-attempted-coup-855206","summary":"Armed men attacked the presidency complex and briefly occupied part of the seat of power. That is negative evidence against effective custody and control of the security apparatus.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.2"]},{"title":"Security mobilization often looked coercive and over-militarized rather than disciplined.","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-02-23","url":"https://www.presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/face_a_la_presse_le_president_felix_tshisekedi_a_peint_un_tableau_despoir_de_la_rdc","summary":"Tshisekedi emphasized a major military buildup and a force-forward approach to eastern insecurity. This shows mobilization, but not necessarily effective or sustainable mobilization.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"His coalition remained shaped by bargaining and patronage.","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-05-29","url":"https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/DR-Congo-names-new-government-after-months-of-delay-46846207/","summary":"Reuters reported that internal jostling delayed cabinet formation for months and the final cabinet remained larger than expected. This is evidence that coalition mobilization was only partly effective and still heavily political.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.2"]},{"title":"The constitutional reform push suggests energy was also going into self-entrenchment.","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-10-24","url":"https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/congo-president-tshisekedi-draws-criticism-over-constitutional-reform-plans-2024-10-24/","summary":"Reuters reported a commission to study revisions that could remove term limits and enable a third term. That is evidence of mobilizing the ruling network toward the ruler’s own power-preservation goals, not just the public program.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.1"]}]}
